detailed_description: The scheme "Assistance to OBM Boat Owner Fishermen on Purchase of Kerosene/Petrol" has been launched by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to fishermen owning small boats with Outboard Motors (OBM) by subsidizing the cost of kerosene or petrol. This initiative supports the fishing community and promotes fisheries in Gujarat.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must be a fisherman. 1. The applicant must be a Kerosene Card holder. 1. The applicant must own a small boat operated by an Outboard Motor (OBM).
